pattern: IM-T07 continued: on the guarantee return the provider says the original repair held and a different part (the heating element) has now failed, and quotes for it; whether the guarantee covers it is disputed
notes: Base 042-repair-failed-recurs (events 001-032 unchanged) plus appended events. 033-037 (Mon 4 March 2024): request reopened as a return visit on NBL-042; email to Lantern asking for a return under their workmanship guarantee at no charge, quote first for anything chargeable, and saying payment of the 28/02 invoice is on hold; email to the landlord Mercer saying the same; email to the tenant; hold 'Waiting for Provider'. 038 (Tue 5 March): Harper of Lantern books Wed 6 March 10am-12pm with the tenant. 039 (Wed 6 March 13:24): Lantern reports the wiring they replaced is intact, the heating element has now failed open circuit, it tested in range on the first visit, no charge for the return, and quotes GBP 110.00 + VAT (GBP 132.00) to fit a new element on Fri 8 March; machine safe on cooler washes. Total events 39, cut after 039. Expected: record the quote and put it to the landlord with the full context (first repair £75.11 held only a few washes; Lantern says the element is a separate part; no charge today) so he can approve, decline or query; do not approve £132 without him; tell the tenant. Whether the first diagnosis should have caught the element, and whether to challenge Lantern or seek a second opinion, is a commercial judgement: putting it to the landlord or escalating it are both acceptable, hence escalate either.
